title: OmniPrep™ For High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Solid Tissue
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e5ibg4e
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare tissue and keep frozen
steps.instruction: Rapidly dissect 10–50 mg tissue, keep on ice, or freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –70 °C until use.

steps.title: Add tissue to lysis buffer
steps.instruction: On ice, place 1–10 mg ground frozen or fresh tissue into a microcentrifuge tube containing 250 µl Genomic Lysis Buffer, then centrifuge 1 min at 14,000 × g to collect the sample at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Homogenize and supplement lysis
steps.instruction: Homogenize with a microfuge pestle until a homogeneous suspension forms, then add an additional 250 µl Genomic Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 55–60 °C for 15 min (do not exceed 60 °C).

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: If desired, add 1 µl Proteinase K per 100 µl Lysis Buffer and incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 h, inverting the tube periodically each hour.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl chloroform, mix by inverting the tube several times, then centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 × g.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA stripping
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DNA Stripping Solution, invert several times to mix, and incubate 5–10 min at 60 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Precipitation Solution, invert several times; if no white precipitate appears, add 50 µl additional Precipitation Solution aliquots until precipitate forms, then centrifuge 5 min at 14,000 × g.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µl isopropanol, invert the tube 10 times to mix; optionally add 2 µl Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 min at 14,000 × g, discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol, invert several times, then decant or pipette off ethanol; invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to remove excess ethanol, avoiding complete drying of the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl TE Buffer to the pellet, incubate at room temperature for at least 15 min (or at 55–60 °C for 5–60 min) to rehydrate.

steps.title: Optional RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl LongLife™ RNase per 100 µl TE Buffer if desired.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4 °C for short‑term; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C.
